items.title: Interview with Dr. Joseph Nkurunziza, Executive Director of Never Again Rwanda
items.description: Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza speaks about the vision and mission of Never Again Rwanda, peacebuilding after the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi, and the role of education and the rule of law in preventing atrocities. Recorded at the Genocide Prevention Forum in Yerevan, Armenia.

items.title: #TheRealTalk with Dr Joseph Ryarasa on Youth, Expression and responsibility
items.description: Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza joins The Long Form Podcast to reflect on Rwandan culture, peacebuilding, and the journey of founding Never Again Rwanda. The full interview is available on the podcast's YouTube channel.

items.title: Criticizing Constant Shifts in Education Reforms
items.description: Dr. Joseph Nkurunziza Ryarasa criticizes constant shifts in education reforms, saying they disrupt continuity and weaken outcomes. He urges a more stable, long-term approach to education policy.

items.title: Welcoming Remarks — Never Again Rwanda
items.description: Never Again Rwanda's Executive Director, Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza, provides welcoming remarks and an in-depth presentation on the journey of the organization.

items.title: Peace Education Initiative — Cross-Border Peacebuilding
items.description: Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza discusses Never Again Rwanda's peace education initiative, part of the Cross-Border Peacebuilding programme in Rwanda, Burundi and the DRC.

items.title: CPA Podcast — Peacebuilding and Prevention
items.description: Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza, Executive Director of Never Again Rwanda, joins Dr Kate Ferguson, Co-Executive Director of Protection Approaches, to discuss peacebuilding and the prevention of identity-based violence.

items.title: True Heroism Starts at Home
items.description: Dr. Joseph Ryarasa reflects on Rwanda's history, noting that true heroism starts at home and that protecting family values is essential for building a strong society.

items.title: My Grandparents Came to Uganda
items.description: Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza shares the story of his family's journey as refugees and the founding of Never Again Rwanda, an organization born from the ashes of the 1994 genocide.

items.title: There Was a Time When Rwandan Refugees Had No Country
items.description: A guest reveal segment featuring Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza, medical doctor, peacebuilder and founder of Never Again Rwanda, reflecting on the Rwandan refugee experience and return.

items.title: Dutch Students Explore the Role of Youth in Peacebuilding
items.description: The opening of a youth peacebuilding exchange was chaired by Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza, Executive Director of Never Again Rwanda, who reiterated the vision behind the Peacebuilding Institute.

items.title: Trauma Healing Needs to Be at the Centre of Peace and Development Efforts
items.description: 25 years after the Genocide against the Tutsi, Dr Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza, Executive Director of Never Again Rwanda, argues that trauma healing must be placed at the centre of peace and development efforts.

items.title: Profile: Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza
items.description: A profile of Dr. Joseph Ryarasa Nkurunziza by Innovations for Poverty Action, highlighting his work as a medical doctor, public health practitioner and social justice activist, and his role as co-founder and Executive Director of Never Again Rwanda and president of the African Democracy Forum.
